agent.problem: The card presents Paul's emotional state as fact with "Paul is HOT about it." If Papa Dorin is inferring Paul's feelings from the force of the question, he needs to mark that as his own impression rather than state it as a fact.

rule.text: He can guess at a feeling, marked as his own ("I think," "I bet"). Never as fact.

agent.problem: This non-opening story card runs to four sentences: Paul's question, "Whew.", the cookie-tray comparison, and the teaser about the next line. It exceeds the one-to-two-sentence limit.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: Verse 11 says the Corinthians were washed, sanctified and justified, but the walkthrough only says they were washed and made right with God. Neither this card nor any other conveys that they were sanctified, leaving out part of Paul's concluding transformation.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
